summary: Body of Jamie Garrett, a Vail resident missing since July 5, found by VMRG near Piney Lake / Piney River Basin north of Vail after a multi-area search (Muddy Pass, Red and White, Shrine Mountain, Eisman Hut areas)
location: Piney Lake / Piney River Basin, north of Vail
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group + Eagle County Sheriff + Vail Police
notes: Vail Daily 2011-07-09 (Lauren Glendenning); fills thin Eagle year 2011.
